Name: BigCola's Better Hats for Content Patcher
Author: minervamaga
Description:
Updates the sprites for the vanilla hats.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

WORKS WITH STARDEW VALLEY 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Credit to [BigCola111](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/40028110)﻿ for the [original mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1485) and thanks for allowing me to do this conversion!

Credit to the following for the mods seen in the previews:
[thingwithwings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45387767)﻿ for the fixed up [mouse house](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1975)
[jinxiewinxie](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8386684)﻿ for their [Get Dressed](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331) mod

Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
